propositions: MCP transition_ticket and claim_ticket omit force, reason, caused_by, and ref parameters that are already supported by the library and CLI.
FastMCP derives JSON schemas and argument models from handwritten callable signatures; undeclared payload keys are discarded before the adapter runs, making these parameters unreachable over MCP.
The MCP adapter forwarding layer independently omits these parameters in its delegate calls to rebar.transition and rebar.claim, so signature-only changes would still fail to propagate the values.

Runtime probes confirmed the mechanism: live MCP schemas lacked all reported fields, capture stubs received only close_class or assignee, equivalent FastMCP tools with declared fields received exact sentinels, and MCP ref selected HEAD instead of the requested commit.
